dogecoin.text: "The thesis in buying any non-cash-flowing asset — Dogecoin, Bitcoin, gold, art, whatever — has to be “other people will want to buy this thing too.""

TikTok is fan fiction for videos.

Twitter is fan fiction for notes.

QAnon is fan fiction for politics.

Dogecoin is fan fiction for finance.

And @lootproject is fan fiction for NFTs.

Soon, all of culture will just be collectivized derivatives.
